title: Approval capture and query: compact evidence format proposal
summary: A tight PRD sketch proposing a compact, query-first evidence envelope for customer-managed networking approval flows. Focus: minimal per-change payloads, indexed fields for fast queries, signed attestations, and retention tiers to balance compliance costs and forensic needs.
background: Private deployments have an explosion of approval-related telemetry: operator approvals, customer handshakes, firewall rule patches, peering changes. Current logs are verbose (full sysconfigs + diffs) which makes storage expensive and queries slow. Customers ask for tamper-evident change proofs and for Redwood to provide fast incident triage UX without shipping full raw configs into our telemetry store.
goals: Define a compact evidence envelope schema that contains the minimum fields required for audit and triage
Ensure each approval event is tamper-evident (cryptographic signing + immutable id) and queryable at low cost
Provide a retention tier model: immediate short TTL for verbose payloads, long TTL for compact indices and signed receipts
Design operator UX and sample queries for rapid incident replay and customer handover
Propose a rollout plan with compatibility for existing approval APIs and control-plane proxies
scope: This doc covers the evidence schema, indexable fields, signing model, retention tiers, query patterns, operator replay UX, and a phased rollout plan for private deployments. It does not rework the underlying control-plane authorization engine or replace SIEM integrations (those are integrations in scope for follow-ups).
out_of_scope: Full encryption-at-rest policies for customer payloads (handled by platform security), deep archival search UI (long-term product project), and on-prem agent mechanics beyond signing + bundle upload interface.
success_metrics: Reduce median forensic query time from 18 minutes to under 90 seconds for common approval queries
Decrease average per-change storage costs for approval telemetry by 60% versus current raw payload retention
Achieve cryptographic verification of evidence bundles for 100% of approval events in Dedicated/Private within 2 quarters
Customer satisfaction NPS for incident handover flow >= +30 in pilot accounts
user_stories: As an operator, I want to see a compact summary of a VPC change and the approval chain in under 2s so I can decide rollback eligibility
As a security reviewer, I want an immutable receipt (signed) that I can present in audits showing who approved a network-peering change
As a customer SOC, I want to run quick queries (by tenant, by operator, by time window, by policy-id) and get lightweight evidence without pulling full config blobs
As a platform engineer, I want to attach a compact proof to a ticket so downstream tools can fetch full artifacts only when necessary
requirements: R1: Evidence envelope must include a stable change_id (UUID), timestamp, initiator, approver_chain, action_type, affected_resources, minimal diff summary, and a cryptographic signature (base64).
R2: A small set of index fields must be stored in the hot index for fast queries: change_id, tenant_id, operator_id, policy_id, resource_tags, timestamp, final_state.
R3: Full verbose artifacts (config diffs, raw logs) may be stored in a cold archive with a shorter default retention and fetched on-demand using the change_id.
R4: There must be a verification API that accepts an evidence envelope and returns a boolean verification plus signer metadata.
R5: Evidence envelopes must be compact (target <= 4 KB) for typical approval flows; anything above 16 KB should be flagged for operator review and archived differently.
R6: The control plane must emit the envelope atomically with approval state transition to prevent TOCTOU gaps.
R7: Retention tiers must be configurable per-customer and support regulatory presets (e.g., EU Finance, Healthcare).
R8: UX must include a one-click replay link that attaches the change_id to the incident and shows a timeline and signed receipts, without automatically loading archived verbose blobs.
R9: Export hooks for SIEM/Customer Kinesis/S3 must be supported; exported payloads should include signature and index fields.
R10: Backwards compatibility shims: allow ingestion of legacy verbose events and compute compact envelopes heuristically where possible.
query_examples: Find approvals for tenant within a time window: SELECT change_id, ts, actor, final_state FROM approvals_index WHERE tenant_id='acme-inc' AND ts BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-01-31' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;
Query by policy id: SELECT change_id, ts, actor FROM approvals_index WHERE policy_id='egress-req-77' AND final_state='applied';

Find suspicious rapid approvals: SELECT change_id, ts, array_length(approver_chain) as approvals FROM approvals_index WHERE tenant_id='acme-inc' AND ts > now() - interval '24 hours' AND approvals < 2;
Operator audit trail: SELECT change_id, ts, action, summary FROM approvals_index WHERE operator_id='n.brooks' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 200;
retention_tiers: Tier 0 (indexes + receipts): keep 7 years (default for compliance), small storage footprint (JSON indexes ~500B each)
Tier 1 (compact envelopes): keep 180 days default - contains summary + signature + small diffs (target <= 4KB)
Tier 2 (verbose artifacts): keep 30 days default - full config dumps, debug logs, diff contexts; moved to cold archive and on-demand fetch
Customer override: customers can extend Tier 1/2 per-contract; platform must provide cost estimates when altering retention
operator_flow: Operator UI shows a timeline card for each change (change_id + 1-line summary + signed receipt icon). Clicking expands a lightweight view (index fields + approver chain). 'Fetch artifacts' triggers a background job to retrieve verbose blobs from cold storage and attach them to the incident; a progress indicator and size estimate are shown. There is also a 'Verify signature' button that calls the verification API and shows signer cert metadata.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (pilot): implement envelope producer in control plane for a subset of private customers and store index fields in a new approvals_index table; expose verification API (Q2 pilot).
Phase 1 (wide opt-in): allow customers to opt into compact envelopes and configure retention tiers; add on-demand artifact fetch UI (Q3).
Phase 2 (default): make compact envelopes the default for all private deployments; add export hooks and regulatory presets; deprecate olderverbose-only retention (Q4).
Migration notes: provide a migration job that scans legacy events and emits computed envelopes for historical queries; surface gaps to customers (missing signer metadata).
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Compact envelope misses a critical field needed for forensic analysis. Mitigation: require a pilot checklist, conservative default fields, and operator flagging when envelope > 4KB.
Risk: Customers want full raw logs retained for long periods causing cost blowup. Mitigation: retention tiers + automated cost estimator and contract UI for approvals of long retention.
Risk: Signing key compromise. Mitigation: rotate signing keys with key-versioning in envelopes and provide CRL/verification endpoints; offer HSM-backed signing for enterprise customers.
Risk: Query patterns break dashboards relying on verbose payloads. Mitigation: provide a translation layer and deprecation timeline + migration tools.
open_questions: Q1: Do we require customer-provided signing keys (recommended for highest assurance) or is platform signing acceptable for most customers?
Q2: Should the default Tier 1 retention be 180 days or configurable at the workspace level with a minimum of 30 days for operational safety?
Q3: Are there any jurisdictions where storing signed receipts for 7 years (Tier 0) will conflict with data deletion laws? Need legal input.
Q4: What is the SLA for on-demand artifact fetches (target 30s for recent artifacts, 5–10 min for deep cold archive)?
next_steps: Schedule a cross-team design review (eng infra, security, SRE, product) and a pilot onboarding with two existing private customers (one regulated, one scale-focused). Build a small prototype producer that emits the envelope to an approvals_index stream and implement the verification API contract. Draft end-to-end test cases and cost-estimate calculator for customer settings.
